news.title: Swan Defence and Heavy Industries Limited Announces Resignation of Independent Director Ashishkumar Bairagra, Effective February 20, 2026
news.body: Swan Defence and Heavy Industries Limited announced that Mr. Ashishkumar Bairagra (DIN: 00049591) has tendered his resignation from the position of Independent Director with effect from February 20, 2026. The resignation was due to personal difficulty at this point in time. Mr. Ashishkumar Bairagra has confirmed that there are no other material reasons for his resignation other than those mentioned in his resignation letter. Mr. Ashishkumar Bairagra does not hold directorship in any listed entity.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: ₹6.28 loss per share (vs ₹10.13 loss in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: ₹6.28 loss per share (improved from ₹10.13 loss in 3Q 2025). Net loss: ₹331.1m (loss narrowed 37% from 3Q 2025). Over the last 3 years on average, the company's share price growth rate has exceeded its earnings growth rate by 164 percentage points per year, which is a significant difference in performance.

news.title: New minor risk - Market cap size
news.body: The company's market capitalization is less than US$100m. Market cap: ₹3.61b (US$40.0m) This is considered a minor risk. Companies with a small market capitalization are most likely businesses that have not yet released a product to market or are simply a very small company without a wide reach. Either way, risk is elevated with these companies because there is a chance the product may not come to fruition or the company's addressable market or demand may not be as large as expected. In addition, if the company's size is the main factor, it is less likely to have many investors and analysts following it and scrutinizing its performance and outlook.
